description.value: Berry Bounty Farms is a four-generation family-run berry operation in Chilliwack's Fraser Valley, cultivating 17 acres of raspberries and 20 acres of blueberries. The year-round self-serve store runs on a debit/credit vending machine stocked with frozen berries, farm-fresh eggs restocked daily, raspberry jams and juices, and Fricey's ice creams. A seasonal roadside stand supplements the store during the summer berry harvest, offering cyclists a distinctive farm-fresh stop along Chilliwack Central Road.

address.value: 48260 Chilliwack Central Road, Chilliwack, BC V2P6H3
